overall_goal: Form and coat potato chicken balls, then wash hands

goals.description: Scoop the potato chicken mixture from the saucepan to form balls
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly scoops the potato chicken mixture from the saucepan into their hands to mold it.

goals.description: Coat the potato chicken balls in egg and flour
goals.rationale: The person rolls the formed balls in a bowl of eggs and retrieves flour to sprinkle over them.

goals.description: Wash and dry hands at the sink
goals.rationale: The person rinses their hands with soap and water, then dries them with a towel and puts the towel away.
